row.evidence: SmartRecruiters' Web SSO guide says the user 'must be created and activated in SmartRecruiters before logging in from an Identity Provider', using its Users API; Okta's provisioning connector works through the SmartRecruiters API key (X-SmartToken), not a SCIM endpoint.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM endpoint is documented in the developer portal (llms.txt index, Users API, Web SSO guides). IdP provisioning runs through the proprietary Users API: Okta's OIN app (marked SCIM on the OIN page) is configured with the SmartRecruiters API key and supports create, profile updates, deactivation and reactivation; Microsoft Entra's tutorial is SSO only with an 'SSO enabled subscription'. Pricing: Essential starts at $14,995 (flat, billing period not stated); Professional, High Volume and Complete are Request Pricing. Which plan includes SAML SSO is not stated. API credentials need an Admin account on the (legacy-named) Corporate Plan. help.smartrecruiters.com redirects to the marketing homepage, so no public help-centre articles could be searched.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Flat starting price; billing period and seat basis not stated.

scim.notes: Users must be created via the proprietary Users API before SAML login; IdP provisioning (Okta) uses that API with an API key.

user_api.notes: Users API (v201804). Credentials are created in Settings > Apps & Integrations > Credentials, which SmartRecruiters says needs an Admin account on the Corporate Plan (a legacy plan name not on today's pricing page).

auth.notes: API key (32 characters, no expiry, full access) in the X-SmartToken header, or OAuth 2.0 (client credentials or authorization code) with users_read / users_manage scopes.

capabilities.notes: No user delete endpoint is listed; deactivation is DELETE /users/{id}/activation. Roles are set via systemRole on create/update; access groups can be assigned and removed.

endpoints.purpose: Update a user (JSON Patch, e.g. ssoIdentifier)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types in the subscription API cover candidates, applications, jobs and offers; no user events were found.

audit_log_api.notes: Requires the ADMINISTRATOR role; events kept at least 26 months. Plan availability not stated.

rate_limits.text: Most endpoints 10 requests per second and 8 concurrent requests per API credential

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate (read from page markup), but Okta's own provisioning guide configures it with the SmartRecruiters API key in an X-SmartToken field, i.e. Okta calls SmartRecruiters' REST Users API. Supports import, push new users, profile updates, deactivation and reactivation; no custom attributes.

entra.notes: Learn tutorial covers SAML SSO only; no provisioning tutorial.

fallbacks.other_sync: Users API (create/activate/deactivate) used by Okta's connector
